== Biography ==

Seven is one of the gardeners at the Queen's garden, painting roses red. When Five splashed paint during their work and blamed Seven for jogging his elbow, Seven replied with "That's right, Five! Always lay the blame on others." Sharp-spoken with his companions, he told Two, "That's none of your business, Two!" when Two interjected in a matter.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Five]]''' — friendly_rivalry. Seems to exchange quips and blame with Five over a painting incident.

'''[[Alice]]''' — ally. Appears connected to the croquet-ground experience, though the nature of this connection is unclear.

'''[[Queen]]''' — enemy. Seems to exist in relation to the Queen's authority, though details remain sparse.
